keyword: high output diesel concrete pump LZ-80 or diesel 120

title.en: High Output on Diesel: Compare LZ-80 and Diesel 120 in Xingtai
title.zh: 柴油大排量：在邢台对照 LZ-80 和柴油120

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai points a high-output diesel buyer to LZ-80, up to 95 m³/h on the low-pressure mode, and Diesel 120 at 100 m³/h with two 145 kW engines. LZ-60 is the third name on that note.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台让柴油大排量买家看 LZ-80（低压模式可达 95 m³/h）和柴油120（100 m³/h、双机 145 kW）。该说明里的第三个名字是 LZ-60。

h1.en: Shortlist the High-Output Diesel Rows by the Mode You Can Name
h1.zh: 按你能点名的模式短名单柴油大排量

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai’s high-output diesel note says to compare LZ-80 and Diesel 120, and it also names LZ-60. LZ-80 prints Yuchai 256 kW, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, conveying 120 m, and delivery height “consult factory standard”. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW from two 145 kW engines, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m / 500 m and hopper 0.6 m³. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. Choose the mode or the page before the quote.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）的柴油大排量说明要求对照 LZ-80 和柴油120，并点了 LZ-60。LZ-80 印玉柴 256 kW，高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa，料斗 0.6 m³，输送距离 120 m，输送高度为“咨询工厂标准”。柴油120印两台 145 kW 合计 290 kW、100 m³/h、40 MPa、150 m / 500 m、料斗 0.6 m³。LZ-60 印 50 m³/h。报价前先选定模式或页面。

body.en: Both LZ-80 and Diesel 120 print 0.6 m³. The engines do not match: one Yuchai 256 kW versus two 145 kW units. Weight is 6800 kg versus 8000 kg.
body.zh: LZ-80 和柴油120都印 0.6 m³。发动机不同：一台玉柴 256 kW，对两台 145 kW。重量是 6800 kg 对 8000 kg。

body.en: LZ-80’s outputs and pressures are printed with ≤. An order that changes ≤ 95 into 95 as a guaranteed rate rewrites the cell.
body.zh: LZ-80 的输送量和压力都带 ≤。把 ≤ 95 改成保证 95 的订单，是在改写格子。

body.en: Write the mode for LZ-80 or the twin-engine line for Diesel 120, plus aggregate. LZ-80 and Diesel 120 both print 6 cm and below. Send [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: 写上 LZ-80 的模式，或柴油120的双机一行，以及骨料。LZ-80 和柴油120都印 6 cm 及以下。发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

question.en: Is 100 m³/h the LZ-80 low-pressure cell?
question.zh: 100 m³/h 是 LZ-80 的低压格吗？

answer.en: No. Low pressure on LZ-80 is ≤ 95 m³/h. 100 m³/h is Diesel 120.
answer.zh: 不是。LZ-80 低压是 ≤ 95 m³/h。100 m³/h 是柴油120。

question.en: Does LZ-80 print a vertical metre?

answer.en: Delivery height says consult the factory standard. No metre is printed there.
answer.zh: 输送高度写的是咨询工厂标准。那里没有印米数。

question.en: Why is LZ-60 on the note?

answer.en: The high-output diesel note includes it beside LZ-80 and Diesel 120. Its own output cell is 50 m³/h.
answer.zh: 柴油大排量说明把它和 LZ-80、柴油120放在一起。它自己的输送量格是 50 m³/h。
